title: The Completion of Creation and the Garden of Eden

verses.1: Thus the heavens and the earth were completed, and all their host.
verses.2: And on the seventh day God completed His work which He had done, and He rested on the seventh day from all His work which He had done.
verses.3: And God blessed the seventh day and sanctified it, for on it He rested from all His work which God had created and made.
verses.4: These are the generations of the heavens and the earth when they were created, in the day that the LORD God made the earth and the heavens.
verses.5: Now no shrub of the field was yet in the earth, and no plant of the field had yet sprouted, for the LORD God had not sent rain upon the earth, and there was no man to work the ground.
verses.6: But a mist went up from the earth and watered the whole face of the ground.
verses.7: And the LORD God formed man from the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life, and man became a living being.
verses.8: And the LORD God planted a garden in Eden, toward the east, and there He placed the man whom He had formed.
verses.9: And out of the ground the LORD God caused to grow every tree that is pleasing to the sight and good for food; the tree of life also in the midst of the garden, and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.
verses.10: Now a river went out from Eden to water the garden, and from there it divided into four rivers.
verses.11: The name of the first is Pishon; it flows around the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold.
verses.12: And the gold of that land is good; bdellium and the onyx stone are there.
verses.13: And the name of the second river is Gihon; it flows around the whole land of Cush.
verses.14: And the name of the third river is Hiddekel; it flows east of Assyria. And the fourth river is the Euphrates.
verses.15: And the LORD God took the man and placed him in the garden of Eden to work it and to keep it.
verses.16: And the LORD God commanded the man, saying, "From every tree of the garden you may freely eat;
verses.17: but from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil you shall not eat, for in the day that you eat from it you shall surely die."
verses.18: And the LORD God said, "It is not good for the man to be alone; I will make him a helper alongside him."
verses.19: And out of the ground the LORD God formed every beast of the field and every bird of the heavens, and brought them to Adam to see what he would call them; and whatever Adam called a living creature, that was its name.
verses.20: And Adam gave names to all the livestock, and to the birds of the heavens, and to every beast of the field; but for Adam there was not found a helper alongside him.
verses.21: And the LORD God caused a deep sleep to fall upon Adam, and he slept; and He took one of his ribs and closed up the flesh in its place.
verses.22: And the LORD God fashioned into a woman the rib which He had taken from the man, and brought her to the man.
verses.23: And Adam said, "This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh; she shall be called Woman, for she was taken out of Man."
verses.24: Therefore a man shall leave his father and his mother and hold fast to his wife, and they shall become one flesh.
verses.25: And the man and his wife were both naked, and they were not ashamed.

metadata.source: Based on the Authorized King James Version (1769), reinterpreted through the theology of abiding in Christ.
